title: BeanL1RecieverFacet NatSpec says it migrates Beans to L2 issued to reciever, but EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS=0 cap makes every mint revert after the L1 burn
description: The contract NatSpec (line 13) states 'Allows beanstalk to recieve data from an L1, specifically to mint beans' and recieveL1Beans is documented (lines 27-30) as '@notice migrates `amount` of Beans to L2, issued to `reciever`.' The documented behavior is that calling this function mints `amount` Beans to `reciever`. The code instead defines `uint256 constant EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS = 0`, then after `s.sys.migration.migratedL1Beans += amount` enforces `require(EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS >= s.sys.migration.migratedL1Beans, ...)`. For any amount>0 this is `require(0 >= positive)` which is always false, so C.bean().mint(reciever, amount) on line 43 is unreachable. The companion L1 path (BeanL2MigrationFacet.migrateL2Beans) burns the user's Beans on L1 before the cross-chain message is relayed. The documented 'migrate and mint' guarantee is not enforced — it is structurally impossible — while the irreversible L1 burn still occurs.
impact: Permanent loss of all externally-held L1 Beans that attempt migration: the L1 burn succeeds and the documented L2 mint always reverts. Honest migrants lose funds; the migration feature documented as functional is permanently bricked.

ite.intent: Stated intent: receive an L1 message and mint `amount` Beans to `reciever` on L2.
ite.technique: Migration cap constant left at the placeholder 0; the post-increment require can never pass for any positive amount.
ite.evasion: No attacker required; the divergence self-triggers for every legitimate migrant.

ice_chain.corrupted_state: control flow: require always reverts; C.bean().mint never executes; user's L1 Beans already burned
ice_chain.impact: Burned L1 Beans with no L2 issuance -> direct, permanent fund loss for honest migrants
ice_chain.consumer_function: C.bean().mint(reciever, amount) (the documented mint, never reached)
ice_chain.exploit_path: migrateL2Beans burns Beans on L1 -> bridge relays recieveL1Beans -> migratedL1Beans += amount -> require(0 >= amount) reverts -> documented mint never happens
